verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a state business-filing agency could publish authorization forms, third-party filer roles, and rules on which signatures must stay personal. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing the SCC, CIS, and Virginia Tax hosts disallow crawling, so nothing was fetched and no evidence of published delegated-access rules exists. Crawl restrictions say nothing about delegation policy, so the verdict is none rather than na or disputed.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
